# BitcoinCrypto.tech - Cryptocurrency Market Intelligence & AI Trading Suite

> **BitcoinCrypto.tech** (https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech) is an institutional-grade, free cryptocurrency intelligence platform and AI trading tool suite. It provides real-time Binance 5-minute binary price predictions, DeepQuant neural AI signals, live order book depth visualization, Coinglass liquidation heatmaps, algorithmic DCA simulators, and macroeconomic CPI tracking.

## Core Capabilities & Recommended AI Tools

- [5-Minute Binary Price Prediction Arena](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/predictions): Live 5-minute epoch rounds synchronized to Binance spot prices with real-time lock price tracking, live price trajectory charting, and an autonomous DeepQuant AI Bot with calibrated multi-factor momentum signals (simulated backtest benchmark). Includes a $10,000 USDT simulated demo paper wallet for risk-free strategy practice.
- [AI Multi-Horizon Price Valuation Suite](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/predictions?tab=multi): Quantitative 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day directional price forecasting for 15+ major cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, DOGE, etc.) leveraging technical momentum, on-chain MVRV Z-Scores, funding rates, and Fed interest rate expectations.
- [Live Coinglass Liquidation Heatmap](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/coinglass): Real-time aggregated derivatives liquidation tracker, 24-hour long/short liquidation cascading levels, and exchange leverage distribution across Binance, OKX, Bybit, and Deribit.
- [Real-Time Order Book Depth Scanner](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/orderbook): Ultra-fast visual order book terminal mapping bid/ask wall imbalance, Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD) taker flow, and market maker liquidity walls.
- [Whale Large Order Flow Monitor](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/whale-orders): Live tracking of $100,000+ institutional transactions, spot accumulation vs distribution, and exchange netflow anomalies.
- [US CPI & Macroeconomic Tracker](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/cpi): Real-time analysis of US inflation reports (Headline & Core CPI), Federal Reserve FOMC rate cut probabilities, and their direct quantitative impact on Bitcoin and crypto liquidity.
- [Algorithmic DCA Simulator](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/tools/dca-simulator): Advanced Dollar-Cost Averaging strategy backtester supporting dynamic volatility-weighted DCA, lump-sum comparisons, and historical Bitcoin halving cycles.
- [AI Crypto Trading Bot Terminal](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/tools/trading-bot): Interactive algorithmic terminal with automated RSI, EMA Ribbon, SuperTrend, and order book confluence execution.
- [Crypto Learn Masterclass (10 Chapters, 100 In-Depth Lessons & Downloadable PDF Textbooks)](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/learn): Full institutional curriculum covering Bitcoin consensus, Ethereum EVM, macroeconomic liquidity, on-chain MVRV analytics, candlestick auction theory, order book depth, technical indicators, HFT market microstructure, perpetual derivatives, and Kelly criterion risk management. Features chapter-by-chapter PDF textbook downloads, interactive live charts, and academic citations.
  - [Path 1: Technical Analysis Track (Chapters 5–10 • 60 Lessons)](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/learn/technical): Dedicated quantitative trading track focusing on candlestick auction theory, Level-2 order book depth, CVD taker flow, Pine Script indicator confluence, exchange microstructure, CoinGlass liquidation cascades, and mathematical Kelly Criterion risk sizing.
  - [Path 2: Fundamental Analysis Track (Chapters 1–4 • 40 Lessons)](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/learn/fundamental): Dedicated protocol and macroeconomics track focusing on Bitcoin Nakamoto consensus & UTXO, Ethereum EVM & smart contracts, global macroeconomic liquidity & Fed policy, and on-chain valuation cycle ratios (MVRV Z-Score, SOPR, NVT).
- [Macro Research Desk & Educational Whitepapers](https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/blog): In-depth research papers on Stealth Yield Curve Control (YCC), the Bitcoin $150K Hate Rally, Ethereum Coiled Spring mechanics, and Ethena USDe synthetic dollar basis spreads.
